name: v18.2.11
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Fixed

- Fixed background job completions interrupting foreground Bash and eval calls, which could cause those calls to be repeatedly moved into the background.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed Claude Opus 5.5 not applying a mid-session switch to high-effort reasoning when the session started without an explicit effort setting.
- Fixed Alibaba Token Plan monthly quotas not appearing in usage reports or the status line.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added built-in StepFun provider support for the step-5-preview model, including live model discovery.

### Fixed

- Fixed cost estimation for OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Sol and Luna models across standard and worker routes.
- Fixed GitHub Copilot Grok 4.x models failing to make requests.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Fixed

- Fixed nested `eval` Todo updates not being reflected by the Todo tracker, including cases where a cell fails after committing an update.
- Fixed strict-mode structured-output validation for JSON Schemas without a root `type`, preserving their `items` and `required` keywords.
- Improved streamed TTSR whole-buffer matching to avoid repeated scans from the beginning of the buffer.
- Fixed plural browser queries when compiled binaries provide shallow stack traces.
- Fixed browser `tab.fill` timing out on pages whose animation frames stall.
- Fixed the first LSP diagnostics request returning no results while a newly started language server is still analyzing.
- `/shake thinking` now reports the number of tokens freed.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Changed

- Improved `warmHighlighter()` so it prepares TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, Bash, Python, Rust, and Markdown highlighting in the background, reducing delays on the first highlight for these languages.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added a Skills section to the settings.
- Enabled OSC 8 hyperlinks in rio.

### Fixed

- Fixed scrolling startup release notes without requiring an initial Escape keypress.
- Improved usage quota display so names remain distinguishable and readable in narrow and multi-column dashboards.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- Added public API contract and authentication schemas for the Skillshare registry.


## What's Changed
* fix(coding-agent/tools): keep native JSON Schema roots out of JTD conversion by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12896
* fix(browser): drive tab.fill and frame actions off puppeteer Locator by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12898
* Add Pi-compatible RPC primitives get_entries(since), get_tree, get_available_thinking_levels to RPC protocol by @44madfire in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12900
* fix(browser): tolerate missing Puppeteer callsites by @Dante-dan in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12902
* fix(tui): preserve distinguishing usage quota labels by @lockwo in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12903
* fix(coding-agent): explain model fallback causes by @lockwo in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12904
* fix(catalog): route Copilot Grok 4.x through the Responses API by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12905
* fix(tui): make startup changelog scrollable after welcome animation by @michaelr in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12906
* feat(coding-agent): expose before_subagent_spawn hook for extensions by @aloyzzz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12907
* fix(coding-agent): report tokens freed by /shake thinking by @Gablinas in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12916
* feat(catalog): added StepFun provider with live model discovery by @ArpitMishra17 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12918
* fix(todo): refresh tracker after nested eval updates by @tommymorgan in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12921
* feat(tui): enable OSC 8 hyperlinks on rio by @abcfy2 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12922
* feat(coding-agent): configure extended context for custom providers by @LingLambda in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12923
* fix(agent): stopped background completions from cascading auto-backgrounding by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12874
* fix(usage): show Alibaba Token Plan monthly quotas by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12877
* fix(codex): update client version for GPT-6 models by @itsddvn in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12885
* perf(coding-agent): avoid repeated whole-buffer TTSR scans by @Dante-dan in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12887
* fix(lsp): deferred provisional cold diagnostics by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12890
* fix(natives): drop the stale minimizer filter generator from pi-natives by @STRML in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12891
* docs: documented OTLP exporter request header env variables by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12897
